description: Implement all Shared dungeon creatures (4 remaining) and Mirror Castle creatures (9 remaining). Total: 13 entity classes with full AI, stats, and behaviors as described in data.js.
steps: Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/NeothelidAdultEntity.java - 320HP, armor 6, tail attack 16 dmg, blind/sound-guided AI with charge, devour, vomit babies, ground slam abilities. Uses large worm model placeholder (Guardian size 2.5x4.0). Extend CDEGeoEntity with SmartBrainLib AI.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/NeothelidBabyEntity.java - 4HP swarm mob, mordisco 2 dmg, follows player if tamed with eggs, can transform into adult if 60+ starve. Small silverfish-sized (0.4x0.3).

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/StitchedWatcherEntity.java - Variable HP elite, wall-mounted watcher with detection/coordination AI. Alerts mobs, activates traps. Eye-based detection mechanics.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/AdventurerWraithEntity.java - 90HP rare ghost, 7 dmg, appears at death locations, repeats last moments, attackable but can be pacified with food. Not immediately hostile.
Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/ReflectionTwinEntity.java - HP equals player, copies player movements/attacks, linked to mirror surface. Mirror Castle elite.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/GlassServantEntity.java - 24HP, 3 armor, 6 dmg, explodes in shards on death, nearly invisible when still near mirror. Vulnerable to blunt.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/QuicksilverMaidenEntity.java - 30HP, 5 dmg, liquid mercury figure that splits when hit and reforms. Fire hardens it. Travels through mirrors.
Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/FrameSentinelEntity.java - 40HP, 6 armor, 7 dmg, animated mirror frame that projects false doors/windows. Crystal is weak point.
Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/SpecularEchoEntity.java - 18HP, repeats player's last action with 1-second delay. Neutralized by doing nothing.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/LanternBearerEntity.java - 22HP, 2 armor, 5 dmg + blindness, hunched servant with lantern that reflects in mirrors to blind. Extinguishing lantern disables it.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/boss/BrokenTwinsEntity.java - 2x120HP miniboss sharing damage pool, specular knights that swap real/reflection roles. Only die if both fall nearly simultaneously.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/boss/LadyQuicksilverEntity.java - 180HP miniboss, mercury witch that converts floors to mirrors and summons mercury hands. Vulnerable only when real reflection exposed.

Create mod/src/main/java/com/colossaldungeons/enhanced/entity/boss/ShatteredSovereignEntity.java - 1200HP boss with 3 phases, composed of mirror shards. Phase 1: knight combat. Phase 2: fragments attack from multiple reflections. Phase 3: inverts room. Each mirror destroyed reduces armor. Implement IBossPhase with BossPhaseManager.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 entity Java files compile syntactically (valid Java 21 with correct imports)
Each entity extends CDEGeoEntity and implements GeoEntity interface
Each entity has a static createAttributes() method with stats matching data.js
Boss entities (ShatteredSovereign, BrokenTwins, LadyQuicksilver) implement IBossPhase
Each entity has registerControllers() with appropriate GeckoLib animations
AI behaviors reference SmartBrainLib or vanilla goal system as appropriate for entity complexity
verification: Check all 13 files exist in correct directories
Verify each file has correct package declaration and necessary imports
Verify createAttributes() methods have HP, speed, damage matching the design document
